question: Does the causally sufficient entry-12 residual state contain a shared A1/A2 target subspace whose P-nuisance complement remains effective and selective?

prior_art.known_lessons: Head-local P complementation removed target transfer; fixed rank-one DAS was construction-specific; complete-state swaps are tautologically sufficient after c-proj interventions; fitting must be opposite-parity and P/C outcomes must not choose a basis.
prior_art.novelty: Move the identification object to the causally sufficient entry-12 state and compare pooled DIM, the fixed two-construction DIM union, and its exact training-P nuisance complement under causal state projection.

frozen_design.fits: For each held parity, use only the opposite parity. Form separate A1-oracle/A1-panel and A2-oracle/A2-panel mean entry12 delta vectors over all semantic-prefix tokens; sign-align and pool them for shared rank-one DIM, or orthonormalize both for a rank-at-most-two construction union.
frozen_design.p_complement: Build the full numerical row span of entry12 P deltas from both experts on training parity at relative singular threshold 1e-6; project both target mean vectors into its exact orthogonal complement, then orthonormalize. No rank, threshold, or regularization selection.
frozen_design.intervention: For each expert and held parity, install off_state + (on_state-off_state)UU^T through each row's semantic position at entry12. Full-state replay and zero-projection arms are controls.
frozen_design.evaluation: Score A1/A2/P/C separately for both fixed oracle experts and held parities. Own target is A1 for A1_oracle and A2 for A2_oracle. No basis is selected after evaluation.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_scope_geometry_f: Hashes and state authority pass; parent/full/zero replays, row coverage, train-held disjointness, orthogonality, finite metrics, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_construction_union_is_target_suff: The fixed construction-union basis projects >=.75 of the full entry12 effect with direction fraction >=.875 in every expert/held-parity own target.
predictions.pred_c_p_complement_preserves_target: The P-complemented union retains at least 90% of the construction-union own-target signed projection and remains >=.675 in every expert/held-parity cell.
predictions.pred_d_p_complement_removes_collision: The P-complemented union has zero P/C top-1 flips and changed-versus-off mean KL <=.02 in every expert/held-parity cell.
predictions.pred_e_shared_rank1_is_construction_gene: The pooled rank-one DIM basis projects >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875 in every expert/held-parity own target.

decision: A failure invalidates. B failure rejects a two-dimensional shared linear state object. B/C/D licenses causal weight translation of the complemented union. B without C repeats the geometric inseparability at the state interface and sends the route to a nonlinear/conditional response basis. C without D shows P collateral outside the training nuisance span. E distinguishes one shared scalar from a two-construction union.
